name: The Girl Who Wasn't There
source:
The Girl Who Wasn't There is a visual novel and the second volume of The Mysteries of Ranko Togawa series.

It's been a while since Ranko and Astrid solved their first case aboard the Marine Express submarine train and their life seemed to have returned to normal, but things don't always turn out the way one expects. After the arrival of a mysterious new student to her class at the prestigious St. Joachim's Academy, Ranko is faced with a new conundrum when she finds an injured girl in the hallways in the middle of the night. However, once she returns with help, the girl has disappeared. What could have happened to her?

The two friends begin an investigation to unravel the mystery but, as is often the case, things soon become complicated. Testimonies and rumors will lead them into St. Joachim's darkest secrets, some of which could put their lives in real danger if they are not careful about the decisions they make. Help Ranko follow the right clues and expose the twisted reality that lies beneath the apparent normality of the academy. 

[From [url=https://1564-studio.itch.io/the-girl-who-wasnt-there]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《不在场的女孩》是视觉小说，也是《十川兰子之谜》系列的第二卷。

兰科和阿斯特丽德在海洋快车潜艇列车上解决第一起案件已经有一段时间了，他们的生活似乎恢复了正常，但事情并不总是像人们预期的那样发展。著名的圣约阿希姆学院的班级里迎来了一位神秘的新生，兰科半夜在走廊里发现了一名受伤的女孩，她面临着一个新的难题。然而，当她在帮助下返回时，女孩却消失了。她可能发生了什么事？

两个朋友开始调查以解开这个谜团，但正如通常的情况一样，事情很快变得复杂。证词和谣言将引导他们了解圣约阿希姆最黑暗的秘密，如果他们不小心做出决定，其中一些可能会将他们的生命置于真正的危险之中。帮助兰科追踪正确的线索，揭露隐藏在学院表面正常现象之下的扭曲现实。

[来自[url=https://1564-studio.itch.io/the-girl-who-wasnt-there]Itch.io[/url]]
